data.one_liner: A customizable counter widget supporting different styles and icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable counter widget that allows incrementing and decrementing values. Supports custom borders, background colors, text styling, icons, and callbacks for state changes.
use_when: You need a quick counter widget with custom styling for shopping cart items or quantities.
You want configurable min/max limits and step increments out of the box.
avoid_when: You need complex state management integration or custom architectures beyond simple callbacks.
You require non-numeric counters or completely bespoke layouts.
strengths: Highly customizable UI attributes like border color, radius, and background.
Supports configurable min, max, and step values.
Includes separate callbacks for increment, decrement, and general count changes.
weaknesses: Limited to a single counter widget use case.
Does not include built-in state management bindings.
data.minimal_example:
CustomizableCounter(
  borderColor: Colors.yellow,
  borderWidth: 5,
  borderRadius: 100,
  backgroundColor: Colors.amberAccent,
  buttonText: "Add Item",
  textColor: Colors.white,
  textSize: 22,
  count: 0,
  step: 1,
  minCount: 0,
  maxCount: 10,
  incrementIcon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: Colors.white),
  decrementIcon: const Icon(Icons.remove, color: Colors.white),
  onCountChange: (count) {},
)
